objective: Reject truncated firmware binary downloads during OTA update before commit in ESP32-C3-CONTROLLER-NODE by validating Content-Length.

acceptance.criterion: perform_ota_update captures Content-Length header from HTTP download response and logs warning if missing
perform_ota_update compares total downloaded bytes against Content-Length and aborts update with MQTT system alert if truncated
Unit tests verify truncation detection logic correctly rejects mismatch and passes matching byte count
ESP32-C3-CONTROLLER-NODE code passes cargo check without errors
